dryRun.description: Prints each change and makes none, as NX_DRY_RUN=true does

cwd.description: Cargo workspace root, relative to the Nx workspace root

packages.description: Workspace crates the crate reaches through path dependencies, published beside it under a dry run

items.description: Workspace crate by its folder, relative to the Nx workspace root, and package name

registry.description: Registry the crate names in its publish list, passed as --registry

__unparsed__.description: Words after -- of the run, appended after the configured arguments

title: Release publish
description: Publishes a crate with cargo publish at the version of the project's tag at the checked-out commit, the tag nx release made from release.releaseTag.pattern, where the registry token variable Cargo reads (CARGO_REGISTRY_TOKEN, or CARGO_REGISTRIES_<NAME>_TOKEN for a named registry) is set and cargo info finds no such version in the registry; names the variable where it is unset, publishes nothing where nx release released no version of the project at that commit or the registry holds it, and under a dry run runs cargo publish --dry-run over the crate and its workspace dependencies whatever the tags; runs through nx release publish
